description: One unit a context accepts. THE LINK IS TO ERPNext's OWN UOM AND NOT TO A STRING, which is the whole reason this row is worth a table: a context listing the word 'Bin' against a site that has no Bin unit is an allow-list that permits something nothing else can store. The install seeds the nine agricultural units into UOM before it seeds any context, so the link always has a target. Every rule about an entry — no duplicates, at most one default, one dimension per context — is a rule about the list it is in, so the checking lives in `agricultural_uom_context.py`.

fields.description: The unit, as ERPNext's UOM register has it. A Link rather than free text: an allow-list naming a unit the site cannot store is worse than no allow-list, because it reads as permission.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: Whether this is the unit a form offers first. AT MOST ONE PER CONTEXT, enforced by the parent — two defaults is the same as none, and which one won would depend on row order. Optional in full: a context with no default is a context where the picker should make somebody choose, which for harvest units is arguably the right answer.
fields.label: Default

fields.description: Why this unit is on the list, where that is not obvious — 'field crews count these, the shed converts them'.
fields.label: Notes
